summary: Pulsenmore Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on September 8, 2026, attaching a press release announcing it completed CE European registration under the MDR for its Pulsenmore FC home ultrasound system for follicular monitoring in fertility care. This is a product regulatory milestone, not a special situation. The filing details no financial terms, acquisitions, divestitures, capital actions, or management changes. It describes expansion into a new market after a prior commercial agreement with Clalit Health Services. Routine operational announcements fall outside special-situation categories.
